ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: in the figure, the straight pole is always vertical, and the ground is horizontal; the person holds the straight pole and moves horizontally from the initial position to the final position, and the horizontal distance is marked as x in the figure; the monkey is upward relative to the pole at the final position, and the height risen along the vertical pole is marked as h in the figure. Then reason: the monkey's displacement relative to the ground can be decomposed into two mutually perpendicular component displacements: in the horizontal direction it moves x together with the person and the pole, and in the vertical direction it moves upward h along the pole. Since the horizontal direction and the vertical direction are perpendicular, the magnitude of the resultant displacement is the hypotenuse of a right triangle with x and h as the legs, namely s=\sqrt{x^2+h^2}.

method.method_draft: 把猴子对地的位移分解为两个相互垂直的分位移：水平方向随人和竖直杆一起移动了 x，竖直方向沿杆向上移动了 h。由于图中和题意都表明竖直杆保持竖直、地面水平，因此这两个分位移互相垂直，猴子对地的合位移就是以 x、h 为直角边的直角三角形斜边，大小为 sqrt(x^2+h^2)。
